title: Pure @Ignister
summary: @Ignister monsters with their A.I. Spells and generic staples; the page's Maliss engine is left out. The 2025 cards lead, and nearly all of them want a Cyberse from the Extra Deck on the field. Backup @Ignister then summons itself and searches a DARK Cyberse, Wizard @Ignister summons itself together with a DARK Cyberse from the GY, Kurikurinku @Ignister negates targeting, and Linkslayer @Ignister can be used as Link Material from the hand and destroys Spells/Traps. Achichi and Ignister A.I.Land still open the turn. Allied Code Talker @Ignister revives the 2300 ATK Cyberse and negates by tributing one of them, and The Arrival Cyberse @Ignister is the Link-6 finisher.
main: Starter: searches a Level 4 or lower @Ignister.
Tuner: summons itself next to an Extra Deck Cyberse and searches a DARK Cyberse.
Summons itself and a DARK Cyberse from the GY; flips a monster's position.
Link Material from the hand; destroys Spells/Traps when used.
Returns an @Ignister from the GY; as Link Material, returns an A.I. card.
Summons itself from the hand or GY; tributes itself to negate targeting.
Searches an A.I. Spell/Trap; sets an @Ignister to Level 4.
Tuner: sends an @Ignister to the GY; revives a Synchro Material.
Summons itself and tributes a Cyberse to search a Level 5+ @Ignister.
Stops an attack; negates a card while you control a Link-6.
Field Spell: summons a Level 4 or lower @Ignister from the hand on an empty board.
Reveals a 2300 ATK Cyberse to search an @Ignister of the same Attribute.
With A.I.Land active, trades a second copy for three cards.
extra: Link-5: revives the 2300 ATK Cyberse and negates by tributing one.
Link-6 finisher: unaffected by other cards, destroys a monster every turn.
Link-3: revives Level 4 or lower @Ignister to its zones.
FIRE Link-3: 2300 ATK Cyberse for A.I. Meet You and Allied Code Talker.
WIND Synchro: 2300 ATK Cyberse for A.I. Meet You and Allied Code Talker.
LIGHT Xyz: 2300 ATK Cyberse for A.I. Meet You and Allied Code Talker.
